experiments.question: Does the selected received witness prescribe one role for each named pitch standard independent of ritual context?
included_inputs_rules: Literal為宮/為角/為徴/為羽 relations and named contexts
held_aside_relationships: Assumed identity of received ritual roles and one modern anhemitonic scale
candidate_adapter_versions: None admitted for cross-domain sound realization; retained bridges remain available for later declared trials
experiments.conditional_result: The selected source relation requires context: multiple named standards receive more than one role across prescriptions.
experiments.exposure_status: Source inspected before extraction; no blind evaluation.
experiments.discarded_information_if_projected: Removing context merges distinct source assignments; physical realization is not supplied by the role labels.
